meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this index was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.

screens.id: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. 'screen-001--login'. Format: 'screen-{NNN}--{slug}'. Never changed after creation.
screens.name: Human-readable screen name, e.g. 'Login'.
screens.module_id: ID of the module this screen belongs to (references module-index).
screens.description: One sentence describing what this screen does from a user perspective.
